query: What governance and decision-rights framework will balance QA/QC, ethics, budget and schedule pressures, and who has final sign-off authority for protocol changes during field rollout?

response.query: What governance and decision-rights framework will balance QA/QC, ethics, budget and schedule pressures, and who has final sign-off authority for protocol changes during field rollout?
response.answer: The governance framework balances QA/QC, ethics, budget, and schedule through a senior management team with final sign-off authority for protocol changes during field rollout. The project lead oversees compliance and ethical standards, while the finance director manages budget and schedule constraints. Final protocol changes require approval from the executive director.

results.content: This will be achieved by: • considering the appointment and performance of the external auditors, as far as the rules governing the appointment permit (and make recommendations to the board when appropriate) • discussing and agreeing with the external auditors, before the audit commences, the nature and scope of the audit as set out in the annual plan • discussing with the external auditors their evaluation of audit risks and assessment of the organisation and the impact on the audit fee • reviewing all external audit reports, including the report to those charged with governance (before its submission to the board) and Report from Audit and Risk Committee 262 of 268 Public Trust Board-25/09/25 Page 6 of 9 ARC Terms of Reference v3.1 any work undertaken outside the annual audit plan, together with the appropriateness of management responses • ensuring that there is in place a clear policy for the engagement of external auditors to supply non-audit services.
